#GuessSimilarityProximity
A Semantle-style word game. Similarity comes from word embeddings (spaCy en_core_web_lg, GloVe-derived), 20,000 words compressed to 160 dimensions and run entirely in your browser.

Rules

Each guess must be a word. Semantle will tell you how semantically similar it thinks your word is to the secret word. Unlike that other word game, it's not about the spelling; it's about the meaning.

The similarity value comes from a word-embedding model: words used in similar contexts score higher, from −100 (opposite) to 100 (the word itself). Typically the secret word's nearest neighbor scores 60–80, the tenth-nearest 40–60, and the one thousandth 20–30.

If your guess is one of the 1,000 nearest words to the secret word, the Proximity bar shows how close it is — 1000/1000 is the nearest word. Otherwise it says "(tepid)" if you're not far outside that circle, or "(cold)".

The daily word changes at midnight and is the same for everyone. Random word gives you a practice puzzle any time. You get unlimited guesses, and Hint shows you a word closer than your best guess so far.
